title: Codex agents' heavy jobs run through the host heavy-job gate
body:
Source: t-qj1tpbe shipped src/hook/heavy-command.ts; `krn standards install --global` writes its `--codex` entry into ~/.codex/hooks.json, but Codex skips a user hook entry until the operator trusts it (per-entry trusted_hash in ~/.codex/config.toml), and a live `codex exec` run with the untrusted entry ran `npm test` ungated. Hook trust needs its own operator grant.
Outcome: the operator trusts the entry once; a verbatim Codex PreToolUse payload capture lands under test/fixtures/codex-hooks and the heavy-command test feeds it to the real entry (KRN-12); Codex-launched heavy jobs (elektroinstal QA replay, measured top CPU user on 2026-11-19) run through heavy-gate.
Proof: a codex exec session's npm test shows KRN_TEST_SLOT_HELD=1, and the capture-fed heavy-command test passes.

Carried from t-qj1tpbe: its load criterion (sampler load below cores x 1.25 while two projects test) was not met on 2026-11-19 (load ~28 from ungated work); this task owns re-measuring it once scheduled services are gated.
